listing.name: Cinematic+  (+ experimental version)
listing.summary: Cinematic+ is a mod that simulates cinematic effects in Starsector. It features effects such as lens flares and dynamic background and star fading. The mod was created specifically for Darksector, but it can also work without it.
listing.aiSummary: Simulates cinematic effects like lens flares and dynamic background fading.

description:
===EXPERIMENTAL VERSION===

Use for testing purpose only!

I'm releasing this version only because I'm not sure when it will be ready, or if it will be ready at all... but I want to share it now.
Added more lens effects related to the stars. Also added lens fading feature that depends on the distance to the star (smoother transitions). New lens effect for wormholes.

download

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1QZ7A9YDD_g--U3uJ5Xu_HGecKBVQElZr/view?usp=sharing

===EXPERIMENTAL VERSION ENDS HERE===

Cinematic+ is a mod that simulates cinematic effects in Starsector. It features effects such as lens flares and dynamic background and star fading. The mod was created specifically for Darksector, but it can also work without it.
All of the demonstrations presented below were achieved using a combination of the Darksector and Cinematic+ mods, as well as the reshade preset for Darksector available on the mod's thread.

This mod is in the early stages of development, it is possible that in the future I will make different variations of lens flares.
Darksector(Click)

==================

Preview

Spoiler
Orange star.

Blackhole

Bronwdwarf

Binary star(orange and white dwarf)

Download Cinematic+
